decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly dumping creatures into the graveyard and then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. By utilizing cards like Unearth, Faithless Looting, and Persist, the deck can efficiently reanimate its key creatures such as Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The strategic use of the graveyard and targeted removal spells make this deck a formidable force in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using artifact creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of attackers. By utilizing cards that generate mana and enable quick plays, the deck can establish a strong board presence early in the game. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and disruption to control the flow of the game. The synergy between cards like Mox Opal, Springleaf Drum, and Urza's Saga allows for explosive turns and the ability to consistently apply pressure to the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful artifacts and Eldrazi creatures. By assembling the UrzaTron lands, the deck can quickly ramp into big threats such as Ugin, Karn, and Thought-Knot Seer. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Warping Wail help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Eldrazi Temple and Expedition Map ensure consistent access to Eldrazi creatures. With a mix of removal, disruption, and powerful threats, the deck aims to dominate the board and outvalue the opponent in longer games.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy involves early aggression with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Guide of Souls. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can provide a game-changing effect by turning all creatures into powerful finishers. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with fetch lands like Arid Mesa and Marsh Flats.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using powerful spells to control the board while dealing damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards that provide card advantage and can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized to support the diverse color requirements of the spells. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast, efficient threats and versatile removal options. By maintaining pressure and disrupting the opponent's strategy, it seeks to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards that allow for graveyard manipulation, such as Faithless Looting and Unearth, to quickly get powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's game plan. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures and disrupt their strategy, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of aggression and control.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using Faithless Looting, Thought Scour, and Unearth, then bring them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Persist. The deck focuses on a combo strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones. Consign to Memory provides additional graveyard manipulation, while Spell Snare and Fatal Push help control the board and protect the combo. Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus add additional utility and disruption to the deck.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling the Allosaurus Combo by tutoring and sacrificing creatures to cheat out Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and other powerful creatures. The deck includes a variety of cards to help search for combo pieces, protect the combo, and generate mana. The key strategy is to ramp up quickly, find your combo pieces, and overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures and combo plays. Additionally, the deck includes some control elements to help protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Guide of Souls, while also using powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board. The deck also has support from cards like Goblin Bombardment and Arena of Glory to ensure constant pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ocelot Pride and Voice of Victory provide additional buffs and benefits to the aggressive strategy, making it a fast-paced and formidable deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive creatures like Solitude, Emperor of Bones, and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to deal damage to the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck is able to "blink" or temporarily remove creatures from the battlefield, allowing for additional damage to be dealt or to protect key creatures. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's strategy while Fatal Push provides removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and strategic blinking tactics.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combo of cards that involve reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty, Emperor of Bones, and Abhorrent Oculus. The goal is to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with cards using spells like Thought Scour and Faithless Looting, then bringing back these creatures with cards like Unearth and Persist. Additionally, the deck includes disruption cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board state and protect the combo.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells such as Spell Snare and Force of Negation, while also removing threats with Prismatic Ending and Wrath of the Skies, the deck aims to maintain control of the board while drawing cards and generating value with Teferi, Time Raveler and Ephemerate. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Quantum Riddler and Solitude to close out the game once it has taken control.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to delay the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Spell Snare and Counterspell, and remove threats with cards like Prismatic Ending and Wrath of the Skies. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to slow down the opponent and protect your spells. Quantum Riddler and Tune the Narrative provide card advantage and help dig for key cards. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly playing artifacts with affinity to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful artifact spells. It utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage while also utilizing Mox Opal and other artifacts to ramp up mana quickly. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Force of Negation and Metallic Rebuke while pushing damage through with creatures like Kappa Cannoneer and Pinnacle Emissary. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to help generate card advantage and close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells while controlling the board with cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, and finish off the opponent with cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Guide of Souls provide additional reach and resilience to the deck's aggressive game plan.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells, using removal, and manipulating the game's tempo in order to establish board control and dictate the pace of the game. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, along with versatile cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Narset, Parter of Veils and Tune the Narrative helps with card advantage and filtering, while cards like Wrath of the Skies and Supreme Verdict act as board wipes to maintain control of the battlefield.
